end.summary:
- Practised identifying point, line segment, line and ray by endpoints and arrows.
- Identified line segments as having two endpoints and rays as having one endpoint.
- Used a torch beam as an example of a ray.
- Teach-back was not passed; the belief that a longer drawing is a different or bigger line remained at the end.
end.parentNote: Aryan practised sorting points, line segments, lines and rays using endpoints, arrows and direction. The torch-beam example helped them identify a ray, and they correctly described segments as having two fixed endpoints. They still mixed up the length of a drawing with the identity of a line at the end of the lesson; this was not corrected after the last time it appeared. At home, ask Aryan to draw two lines of different lengths and explain that both represent lines because each extends in both directions.
